test_cases.title: A tabulation is added to a scheme, renamed and removed
acs: DERIVED: The Results Tabulations tab adds, renames and removes tabulations - Scheme.aspx lnkAddTabulation, lnkRenameTabulation

steps.action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
steps.expected: The scheme page opens.

steps.action: Open the Results Tabulations tab, click Add New Tabulation, enter a unique name and click Add Tabulation, then Save.
steps.expected: The tabulation is listed after a reload.

steps.action: Click Rename on it, enter a new name, click Rename Tabulation and Save.
steps.expected: The tabulation is listed under the new name.

steps.action: Click Remove on it, confirm and Save.
steps.expected: The tabulation is gone after a reload.

steps.action: Check the page.
steps.expected: No server error page is shown.

test_cases.title: A test consultant of a scheme is changed, kept after reloading and restored
acs: DERIVED: The Test consultants tab keeps three consultant choices - Scheme.aspx DropDownTestConsultant1..3

steps.action: Open Manage Schemes > Schemes and click Details on the first scheme.
steps.expected: The scheme page opens.

steps.action: Open the Test consultants tab and note the choice of the slot of the row.
steps.expected: The original choice is known.

steps.action: Choose another consultant in that slot and click Save.
steps.expected: The change is saved.

steps.action: Reload the scheme and open the tab again.
steps.expected: The slot shows the new choice.

steps.action: Put the original choice back and Save.
steps.expected: The original choice is stored.
